policy: Public targets supplement but never replace the exact original English. Valid language and compliance with a specifically stated target remain different grading questions. Source-dependent details are reconciled before contract acceptance.

targets.target_specification: Bounded at-length expression; preterite cease with genitive rule/domain, rather than a manufactured infinitival bear-rule construction.
Possessed kingdom and forty-year duration; distinguish lexical had from a perfect auxiliary and retain the numeral scaffold.
Direct when question, plural bridge subject and past agentless passive with the newly assigned building participle.
Today and future-state context with the taught copular series; accompanying person in the dative.
Accusative what question, Roman plural subject and explicitly requested preterite build; bounded Britain location.
Present send with accusative sent person, agreeing possessives and the specified before phrase; preserve the original face wording.
Singular coming/bringing commands, plural letter object and relative object clause with a stated selected you-number; preserve the original ambiguous unnumbered you.
Promised thing and dative promisee; the source196d control calls for the selected dependent subjunctive in the if clause.
Command send with dative recipient and masculine accusative army, with adjective agreement and no translated indefinite article.
First-person present fighting with the opponent governed by the selected with construction; possessive agrees with plural enemies.
Expulsion command and accusative foes; selected singular/plural addressee must match the possessive.
Plural soldier subject, simple preterite travel and directional home.
Future reference without a compulsory willan auxiliary; accompanying collective fleet and omitted indefinite article.
Explicit singular command and all-who relative object; the finding verb has its own selected finite form.
Singular harvest, rich predicate and the separately scoped in-fruits relation.
Coordinated seedtime/harvest subjects, intransitive cease/fail and bounded never/future reference; do not infer the complete negative-concord system.
Lexical possession, four and the selected season sense; ordinary have is distinguished from the auxiliary construction.
Predicate possession by a genitive title; obey Cook’s article omission.
Personified sea as seeing and fleeing subject; the selected masculine lexical gender governs pronoun reference.
Future-reference flee with accusative thing avoided and full agreement of the iron adjective.
Complete generic relative–temporal–main chain, supported negative copula/owning form, and the distinct nonshepherd/wolf subjects; no part of the long prompt omitted.
Two possessive predicates followed by all three transitive completed-action clauses with habban; preserve every coordinated object and Earth genitive.
First-plural exhortations, city/wall/tower/gate plurals, specified around and before constructions, and contemporaneous while clause with exact gīet hint retained.
Bounded more-than quantity comparison and ability plus infinitive expel; the nations remain the object of expulsion.
Connected singular commands, sea destination, hook object, first fish with proper adjective choice, and mouth opening.
Future finding, masculine penny reference and singular take/give commands, with the specified for-me/for-thee expression.
Past saying with direct present-state speech; negative copula help remains available.
Past taking and saying, feminine possessor, addressed maiden and singular rising command.
Stone-wall adjective agreement and both genitive measure phrases; full foot paradigm and visible higher-numeral support as contracted.
Accusative leave-taking, dative announcement and reported prospective visit/refusal; preserve never more and do not assert a completed visit.
Articled weak adjective names righteous people; plural bold predicate and as-lion comparison without an indefinite article.
Plural Britons and an agreeing cowardly predicate in the past.
Singular come command, directional hither, and weak adjective in direct address to the maiden.
Neuter people and happy predicate, with a genitive relative whose inside the following clause; distinguish antecedent case from internal relative function.
Plural learning command with æt, reason clause, heart-respect expression, future finding and plural souls as beneficiaries.
Present sending of plural people, as-sheep comparison and the specified among-wolves construction.
Temporal when, explicitly evidenced pursuing frame, location in this city, plural flight command and supported ellipsis in the motion-to-another-city phrase.
Present leave-taking with accusative native land and agreeing first-person possessive.
